study_type_evidence.quote: pharmacokinetic analysis of Au_CR demonstrated a half-life of ~17.5 h after intravenous (iv) injection into mice
the incubation of Au_CR with plasma at 37 C for 24 h had no apparent effect on its antibacterial activity against S. aureus, indicating its high plasma stability
We also tested their cytotoxicity against human HaCaT keratinocyte cells and human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs).

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: C57BL/6; sex and age not reported in the available body text
in_vivo_species.quote: We first investigated whether it would rescue C57BL/6 mice infected with a lethal dose of S. aureus.

ex_vivo_detail: Au_CR was incubated with plasma at 37 C for 24 h and residual antibacterial activity against S. aureus was measured (Table S3); the species of origin of the plasma is not stated in the available body text. Hemolysis was assessed at concentrations up to 100 ug/mL (Figure S3) but the erythrocyte source species is likewise not stated. Lung, liver and spleen homogenates and histology sections were taken from treated mice for bacterial load and H&E analysis.
in_vitro_detail: MIC determinations against E. coli, Bacillus subtilis, S. aureus and Candida albicans plus 19 clinical S. aureus isolates; killing kinetics and 60-passage resistance selection; biofilm formation, biofilm eradication and persister-cell killing assays; propidium iodide membrane permeabilization by fluorescence microscopy and flow cytometry; DiSC3(5) membrane potential assay; TEM and SEM of treated bacteria; cytotoxicity in human HaCaT keratinocytes and HUVECs; DOPC/DOPG (7:3) unilamellar vesicle leakage assay with DiI and Fluo-4. All-atom and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations were also run (computational, not an experimental study type).

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetic profile of Au_CR via intravenous injection at Au dose of 10 mg/kg.
concentration_time_figure.note: The figure is described as a pharmacokinetic profile after a single intravenous dose and is cited as the source of the ~17.5 h half-life; the plotted matrix and concentration units are not stated in the available body text. Fig. 5B is a 48 h organ biodistribution bar chart, not a concentration-time plot.

bioanalytical_quote: No assay for quantifying Au_CR in vivo is described in the available body text; the file contains no Methods section and the pharmacokinetic result is reported only as 'pharmacokinetic analysis of Au_CR demonstrated a half-life of ~17.5 h'.
notes: The supplied full-text file contains no METHODS section and carries a truncation marker ('One or more long lines were truncated at 2000 characters'), so dosing details, animal numbers per PK group, sample matrix and the bioanalytical assay are not recoverable from the body. The only PK datum in the body is the ~17.5 h half-life for Au_CR after intravenous injection, with no phase named, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and both half_life_absorption and half_life_elimination are left as not reported rather than inferred. No Cmax, tmax, AUC or rate constant appears anywhere in the body. The PEPLIFE2 header states the matrix as mice plasma and the assay as ICP-MS; that is database metadata and was not used, so half_life_matrix and bioanalytical_method are recorded as not reported. Group size for the PK panel is given only as 'three independent experiments', not as animals per group. ex_vivo_origin is 'not reported' because the body does not state the species of the plasma used in the 24 h stability incubation or of the erythrocytes in the hemolysis assay. Molecular dynamics simulations (all-atom and coarse-grained) and the DOPC/DOPG vesicle work are computational and cell-free respectively and were not counted as separate study types beyond in vitro.
